headline_marked: World Cup Fever: [[Argentina and Spain clash in final]] as fans gather in BD
headline: World Cup Fever: Argentina and Spain clash in final as fans gather in BD
summary: Thousands of football fans in Dhaka and Chattogram gather around big screens to witness the high-stakes showdown between Argentina and Spain.
details: The World Cup final between Argentina and Spain has sparked massive celebrations and excitement across Bangladesh. Thousands of supporters have gathered in the Dhaka University area and Kazi's Deuri in Chattogram to watch the match on big screens.
Fans are decked out in their favorite team's jerseys, waving flags, and painting their faces to show their support for the legendary Lionel Messi and the Spanish squad.
The match takes place in the United States, with Argentina seeking a fourth title on American soil, mirroring their historic success in 1930.

Lionel Messi has expressed his confidence, stating that regardless of the outcome, history has already been made. Meanwhile, Spain enters the final with a strong performance record, having scored three more goals than Mbappé in the tournament.
Experts and football analysts in Bangladesh, including Zahid Hasan, believe Argentina has a higher probability of winning the cup this time.
The atmosphere in Bangladesh is reflecting a global phenomenon where football fever transforms into a collective joy, with experts noting how such events boost the overall mood of the people.
caption:
Argentina vs Spain! The world stops as the mega-final begins. Who will take the trophy home?

The World Cup final between Argentina and Spain has sparked massive celebrations and excitement across Bangladesh. Thousands of supporters have gathered in the Dhaka University area and Kazi's Deuri in Chattogram to watch the match on big screens.

Fans are decked out in their favorite team's jerseys, waving flags, and painting their faces to show their support for the legendary Lionel Messi and the Spanish squad.

The match takes place in the United States, with Argentina seeking a fourth title on American soil, mirroring their historic success in 1930.

Lionel Messi has expressed his confidence, stating that regardless of the outcome, history has already been made. Meanwhile, Spain enters the final with a strong performance record, having scored three more goals than Mbappé in the tournament.

Experts and football analysts in Bangladesh, including Zahid Hasan, believe Argentina has a higher probability of winning the cup this time.

The atmosphere in Bangladesh is reflecting a global phenomenon where football fever transforms into a collective joy, with experts noting how such events boost the overall mood of the people.

headline_marked: Waste dispute: [[Cleaner shot in Dhaka]] over garbage depot
headline: Waste dispute: Cleaner shot in Dhaka over garbage depot
summary: Touhid Hossain, a 28-year-old cleaner, was shot in the leg during a conflict over waste disposal in the Baridhara area of Notun Bazar.
details: A 28-year-old cleaner named Touhid Hossain was shot in the leg on Sunday evening in the Baridhara area of Notun Bazar, Dhaka.
The incident occurred in front of a garbage depot during a dispute over waste disposal.
According to Touhid's colleague, Kamrul Islam, there had been an ongoing conflict with the local Helal Group over the use of the depot.
The attack happened suddenly while Touhid was attempting to dispose of waste at the depot on Sunday night.
Following the shooting, Touhid was rescued and taken to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for emergency treatment.
Inspector Mo. Faruk of the Dhaka Medical College Hospital police outpost confirmed the incident, stating that Touhid was later transferred to the Pangu Hospital for further care.
The matter has been reported to the respective police station for further investigation.
caption:
A dispute over a garbage depot in Dhaka ends in gunfire. A cleaner was shot in the leg during a conflict over waste disposal.

A 28-year-old cleaner named Touhid Hossain was shot in the leg on Sunday evening in the Baridhara area of Notun Bazar, Dhaka.

The incident occurred in front of a garbage depot during a dispute over waste disposal.

According to Touhid's colleague, Kamrul Islam, there had been an ongoing conflict with the local Helal Group over the use of the depot.

The attack happened suddenly while Touhid was attempting to dispose of waste at the depot on Sunday night.

Following the shooting, Touhid was rescued and taken to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for emergency treatment.

Inspector Mo. Faruk of the Dhaka Medical College Hospital police outpost confirmed the incident, stating that Touhid was later transferred to the Pangu Hospital for further care.

The matter has been reported to the respective police station for further investigation.
